name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up), Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, key_lost) correctly capture the task requirements; the machine reflects them with the right states, guards and rewards.

texts: Eventually pick up the target box.
Open the door before picking up the target box.
Do not lose the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened.
